thread:
maya (PM): quick sync — after launch we got a small cluster of embedding timeouts for some Dedicated tenants. want to decide short-term mitigation vs roadmap work. cc @aj @sam @tom

aj (Eng Lead): what does staging repro say? if it's batch-size related we can cap quickly; otherwise might be model kv-cache sizing.

sam (ML Eng): early signal: when batch > 10 p95 jumps. model memory footprint + kv cache growth looks like the culprit for long sequences.

tom (SRE): logs: `ERROR embed-svc timeout req=xyz batch=16 dur=87s` — customer traces match. we should avoid full revert.

lee (Customer Success): customer-D is impacted and asking for ETA. they'd accept temporary cap if it restores SLA fast.

rachel (Design): separate ask from customer about recall improvements — that's an enhancement/roadmap item, not a hotfix.

maya (PM): proposals: A) soft cap per-tenant (fast, low risk) B) revert batching change (risky) C) epic for robustness (days-weeks). recommend A + create epic.

aj (Eng Lead): I can ship per-tenant cap behind flag. PR ~45m–1h. will add quick telemetry to detect noisy tenants.

sam (ML Eng): for the epic I can draft tuning experiments: kv-cache sizing, smaller-quant profiles, sequence truncation heuristics. link to RDW-420.

tom (SRE): I'll wire the flag in infra and add alerting for p95/p99 and tenant-level errors.

maya (PM): plan: AJ -> PR + canary today; TOM -> infra rollout and monitor; SAM -> epic spec RDW-420; RACHEL -> customer comms. owners assigned.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @aj at 1800000120. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

aj (Eng Lead): PR created: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/501 — adds tenant-cap feature flag. requesting @tom review.

tom (SRE): staging QA: batch=16 -> 88s, batch=8 -> 20s. cap 8 looks safe. approving.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @aj at 1800000120. Canary in us-east-1.

tom (SRE): canary stable after 12m. p95/p99 improved, no timeouts on sample tenants.

maya (PM): :white_check_mark: mitigation rolled. RDW-420 created for "Embeddings robustness" — will groom with triage team next Tuesday to decide priority vs other roadmap bets (recall improvements vs infra cost).

lee (Customer Success): customer-D reports SLA metrics back to normal. they asked to be invited to demo when robustness work lands.

aj (Eng Lead): next steps: add small experiments list to RDW-420 and schedule a 3-day spike if PM prioritizes.

maya (PM): thanks all. closing this thread and moving notes to the sprint board. owners: aj (mitigation), sam (epic spec), tom (monitoring), rachel (comm), maya (PM).
